title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 3.89 (versions follow prime numbers; 389 after 383): Luma stays in the branch that served her. Her best line came from a book that lives in a branch of her tree of themes: she stays there, and her next answer starts there. If nothing there shares a word with what was said, she climbs one step and reads only what she has not read yet, up to the root. Tested in a copy: she stayed in branch 21 for same-theme questions and climbed when the theme changed. Answer times were not measured reliably (her talk with her books adds lines the instrument counted). Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v3.89: Luma se queda en la rama que le sirvió. Prototipo de investigación.
